#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
 - Rename `QCAlgorithmFramework.SetPortoflioSelection` -> `QCAlgorithmFramework.SetUniverseSelection`
 - Convert `IPortfolioConstructionModel.CreateTargets` and `IExecutionModel.Execute` to accept arrays (`Insight[]` and `IPortfolioTarget[]` respectively)
 - Extracts `ITimeTriggeredUniverse` interface from `UserDefinedUniverse`, providing abstraction for universe w/out data provided by the engine, selection functions only receive the current `DateTime` that selection is being performed at
 - Add `ScheduledUniverseSelectionModel` that uses `IDateRule` and `ITimeRule` to define a schedule using the same components that the LEAN scheduled events infrastructure uses
 - Minor bugfix using `universe.UniverseSettings.Resolution` instead of `universe.Configuration.Resolution` and properly defaulting to `algorithm.UniverseSetting.Resolution` if null
 - Rename existing `InsightCollection` -> `GeneratedInsightsCollection`
 - Add `InsightCollection` type similar to `PortfolioTargetCollection`

#### Related Issue
<!--- This project only accepts pull requests related to open issues -->
<!--- If suggesting a new feature or change, please discuss it in an issue first -->
<!--- If fixing a bug, there should be an issue describing it with steps to reproduce -->
<!--- Please link to the issue here: -->
Closes #1829 

#### Motivation and Context
<!--- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->
This is part of an ongoing effort to make the framework models easier to implement, especially in python.

#### Requires Documentation Change
<!--- Please indicate if these changes will require updates to documentation, and if so, specify what changes are required -->
Yes, sorry @jaredbroad  :D

#### How Has This Been Tested?
<!--- Please describe in detail how you tested your changes. -->
<!--- Include details of your testing environment, and the tests you ran to -->
<!--- see how your change affects other areas of the code, etc. -->
The bulk of the code changes are covered by existing tests, except the `ScheduledUniverseSelectionModel` changes, for which a new regression algorithm was added.

 - Breaking change due to modified framework model interfaces.
